text:
maya: quick sync — we need a lightweight discovery/probe API that definitively tells SDKs what a model supports: streaming, function/tool calling, token caps, and stable error codes. who wants to lead the spec?

luke: I can own it. minimal payload, machine-friendly fields, and clear error contract. will draft a sample JSON.

olivia: runtime needs these fields exposed as primitives so clients can make deterministic decisions: max_total_tokens, max_prompt_tokens, max_response_tokens, streaming_supported (bool), stream_protocols (list), tokenization_version (string), function_call_mode (disabled|suggest|enforce), tools (list of {id,min_version,capabilities}), stability_label (experimental|beta|stable).

matt: +1. add fallback_model for clients to call if a feature is missing and error_codes mapping. Also prefer a short cache_ttl and rate_limit_hint so SDKs avoid hot loops.

anya: compliance asks: tokenization must be deterministic. include tokenizer_test_vector_url and canonical tokenizer version. acceptance tests will use that.

luke: draft example I'll put in the PR (condensed for Slack):
```
MODEL: redwood/titan-lx-8k
capabilities: streaming_supported=true; stream_protocols=[sse,ws]; max_total_tokens=8192; max_prompt_tokens=6000; max_response_tokens=2048; tokenization_version=redwood-v1; function_call_mode=enforce; tools=[search@1.2.0,rerank@2.0.0]; stability=beta; fallback_model=redwood/titan-lx-8k-no-stream; cache_ttl_sec=300; rate_limit_hint_per_min=60
errors: TOKEN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, TOOLS_NOT_AVAILABLE, STREAM_NOT_SUPPORTED (each returns details.exceeded_by / details.missing_tool)
```

olivia: few suggestions: 1) return tools as simple strings in probe but SDKs should fetch a separate /tools endpoint for details; 2) include streaming_grace_ms for quick client switching heuristics; 3) provide a short human_readable_hint to help SDKs choose fallback.

matt: rollout proposal: stage A = read-only probe responses for hosted models; stage B = runtime-enforced caps + canonical errors; stage C = request-time tools allowlist (RBAC + audit logs).

maya: prod GA criteria (sketch): probe coverage >=95% models; SDKs (py/ts) surface capabilities + run tokenizer test vectors; e2e fallback tests for streaming->nonstream & tools->no-tools; error_contract in docs; perf impact <5% p50; migration guide.

anya: acceptance harness details: SDK runs tokenizer_test_vector, asserts token count <= advertised max_prompt_tokens, then sends a request intended to exceed prompt cap and expects TOKEN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with details.exceeded_by integer. reproducible across locales.

luke: will add details.exceeded_by to the error contract and recommended_client_fallback text; will open PR with sample payload + tests by EOD Fri.

olivia: runtime note: we can auto-generate stubs for quantized variants but mark as stability=experimental. ensure the probe response includes a deprecation_notice field if a flag will be removed soon.

matt: SDK mapping rules: function_call_mode -> SDK behavior: disabled = no function calling UI; suggest = surface but don't enforce; enforce = server-side enforcement + FUNCTIONS_UNAVAILABLE error if mismatch.

maya: action items:
- luke: PR w/ example payload, error contract, recommended_client_fallback (EOD Fri)
- olivia: implement probe endpoint + host tokenizer test vectors (2w)
- matt: SDK mapping & fallback tests (2w)
- anya: compliance harness + test vectors (2w)

dev-bot: opened issue #4275 "probe-api: capability discovery + enforcement" assigned to luke, olivia, matt, anya

luke: will tag eng-runtime, sdk, and docs teams once PR is up. anything else?

maya: ensure probe response is cacheable and rate-limited. also prefer an option to opt-out of exposing internal tool ids for security (e.g., tools: ["restricted"]). thanks! :white_check_mark:
